description: Every US ETF this server can answer for, with the date of the data and where the holdings come from: the issuers' own daily files (tickers), or SEC filings for the other US stock ETFs (tickers_sec_nport), so it also tells whether a given fund is covered. With query it returns only the funds whose ticker or name matches, with their names; include_tickers false returns the counts and dates alone.

include_tickers.description: false leaves out the ticker lists.

query.description: A ticker or words from a fund's name, for example VOO or semiconductor. Case does not matter.

source.description: Only the funds read from the issuers' own files, or only those from SEC filings.

name: list_funds
title: List covered US ETFs
